item.tib: rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs yid bzhin dbang rgyal las bum gter 'dzug thabs
item.coloph: ces gnodasbyin nor gyi bdag po rnam thos sras kyi bum gter 'dzug thabs gter gyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kun grol grags kyis 'phral du sug bris bgyis pa chu glang hor zla'i tshes su grub pa'o//
